title: Sound Transit Arrival And Departure
description: Schema for a real-time arrival or departure prediction from the Sound Transit OneBusAway API

serviceDate.description: Service date in milliseconds since Unix epoch

stopSequence.description: Sequence number of this stop within the trip

scheduledArrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

scheduledDepartureTime.description: Scheduled departure time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

predictedArrivalTime.description: Real-time predicted arrival time in milliseconds (0 if no prediction)

predictedDepartureTime.description: Real-time predicted departure time in milliseconds (0 if no prediction)

predicted.description: Whether real-time prediction data is available for this arrival

status.description: Status of the arrival (ON_TIME, EARLY, DELAYED, etc.)

tripHeadsign.description: Destination headsign displayed on the vehicle
